bias.en: Rebound holding · above the 10-day, capped under the 5-day
bias.zh: 反弹维持 · 守在 10 日均线上方，受制于 5 日均线

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 2.1% on Nov 3 to $150.79, trading between $149.79 and $154.05 on light volume; there is no 100-day yet (82 sessions). It is below the rising 5-day ($154.9) and falling 30-day ($163.7) averages and above the rising 10-day ($147.4). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 28, below zero, histogram roughly flat; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($133.53), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月3日上涨 2.1%，收于 $150.79，盘中区间 $149.79–154.05，成交量偏低；上市仅 82 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于上行的 5 日（$154.9）和下行的 30 日均线（$163.7）下方，并高于上行的 10 日均线（$147.4）。MACD 自 10月28日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图大致持平；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$133.53），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The $146.3–147.4 support (10-day, Nov 2 low) held again, while the $154.05 high stalled at the $152.4–154.9 resistance. Resistance is $152.4–154.9 (Oct 14 high, Nov 3 high, 5-day), then $156.1–157.7 (Nov 2 high, Oct 28 and Sep 3 lows) and $163.7–166.1 (30-day, Oct 28 high). Support is $146.3–147.4, then $145.3–145.6 and $139.2–139.9. A close above $157.7 would target $164–166; below $145.3, $139–140.

r.en: Nov 2 high $156.06; Oct 28 low $156.5; Sep 3 low $157.7

bias.en: Rebound stalling · lost ₩1.44 million, holding the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹停滞 · 失守 144 万韩元，守住 10 日均线

read.en: SK hynix closed at ₩1,398,000 in Seoul, down 5.0% from ₩1,472,000 in the latest completed Seoul session (₩1,379,000–1,433,000). It is below the rising 5-day (₩1,442,400) and 200-day (₩1,503,175) and the falling 30-day (₩1,539,900) and 100-day (₩1,813,840), and just above the rising 10-day (₩1,381,500). MACD has been above signal since Oct 27, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 26 (₩1,275,475), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: SK 海力士在首尔收于 ₩1,398,000，较前一收盘 ₩1,472,000 在最新完整的首尔交易日下跌 5.0%（区间 ₩1,379,000–1,433,000）。股价位于上行的 5 日（₩1,442,400）和 200 日均线（₩1,503,175）以及下行的 30 日（₩1,539,900）和 100 日均线（₩1,813,840）下方，略高于上行的 10 日均线（₩1,381,500）。MACD 自 10月27日起位于信号线上方，仍在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月26日起看多（₩1,275,475），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The drop lost the ₩1,449,000 support (Oct 29 high), now resistance, and the 5-day, but the ₩1,379,000 low held the 10-day and Oct 29 low. Resistance is ₩1,433,000–1,449,000 (5-day, Nov 2 and Oct 29 highs), then ₩1,495,000–1,503,175 (200-day, Oct 27 and Nov 1 highs). Support is ₩1,379,000–1,381,500, then ₩1,358,000 and ₩1,275,000. A close above ₩1,449,000 would target ₩1.50 million; below ₩1.379 million, ₩1.36 million.

r.en: 5-day average ₩1,442,400; Nov 2 high ₩1,433,000; Oct 29 high ₩1,449,000, lost
